liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-31.mtx.tobin.105029.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 36 songs; 246 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the matrix a work of art, praising the mixers' effort; Listener finds the recording smokin' while listening to the third song; Audience noise is so loud that soundboard tracks sound like matrices [16][17][19]
- **gd1980-12-31.sbd.cousinit.17693.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 35 songs; 240 min [3]
- **gd1980-12-31.155390.PandP-sbd.gems-tobin.flac16**: soundboard; 36 songs; 228 min [6]. Said about its sound: GEMs soundboard ran fast, averaging about 1.2 seconds per minute [6]
- **gd1980-12-31.155424.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: source not stated; 36 songs; 228 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]
- **gd1980-12-31.nak700.wagner.miller.107822.flac16**: source not stated; 34 songs; 243 min; rated 1.67/5 by 3 [11]. Said about its sound: Acoustic opening set is exceptional, avoiding the usual wash that hurts Phil [26]
- **gd1980-12-31.GEMS.sbd.108290.flac16**: soundboard; 26 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [14]. Said about its sound: Set two sound is incredible, with newer tunes from 'Go to Heaven' shining [20]

## Around the show

- W. Matt Kelly joined for Little Red Rooster; John Cippolina for Fire On The Mountain [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-31.mtx.tobin.105029.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [1]
- **gd1980-12-31.sbd.cousinit.17693.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Cousinit; source: MSR>C [3]. Also: Recording includes segments from Dire Wolf through the first part of To Lay Me Down [3]
- **gd1980-12-31.155390.PandP-sbd.gems-tobin.flac16**: transferred by Patched and pitch corrected Soundboard by Kevin Tobin; source: Patched and pitch corrected Soundboard [6]. Also: Mixed by an archive user, using GEMs soundboard and removing dead air [6]
- **gd1980-12-31.155424.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) mixed in Adobe Audition CC 2014 [7]. Also: Mixed by an archive user, with FLAC conversion done on January 23, 2022 [7]
- **gd1980-12-31.nak700.wagner.miller.107822.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/TDK SA-X90/Dolby B) [11]. Also: Bob Wagner got in front of the board to capture the difficult venue [26]
- **gd1980-12-31.GEMS.sbd.108290.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: SBD master cassette > cassette; [14]
